summary: This diff adds a live exchange-rate feed (open.er-api.com, no key required) as a purely additive layer on top of the existing manual exchange-rate CRUD: a DB-free, unit-tested HTTP client (exchange-rate-feed-client.ts) with a pure rate-inversion helper, a shared refreshOrgLiveRates core reused by both an on-demand per-org endpoint and an all-orgs cron sweep, a new source ('manual'/'live') column with a safe additive migration (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ... DEFAULT 'manual'), and a once-daily vercel.json cron entry. I independently verified the parts most likely to hide a real bug rather than trusting the self-report: withTenantContext wraps its callback in an actual db.transaction, so the delete-then-insert of that day's source='live' rows is atomic; the currency code interpolated into the external feed URL is admin-entered free text but is URL-encoded into a fixed-domain (open.er-api.com) request, so there's no SSRF vector despite the lack of ISO-code validation; and the new refresh endpoint's auth posture (requireAuth() only, no extra RBAC check) exactly matches the pre-existing sibling endpoints (POST /api/erp/currencies, POST /api/erp/exchange-rates) and the established evaluateAllMetricAlertRules cron precedent, so it introduces no new authorization regression even though, like those siblings, any authenticated org member can trigger it. The cron route fails closed when CRON_SECRET is unset. Idempotency is scoped correctly to (orgId, rateDate, source='live'), never touching manual rows or prior days. Test coverage for the new client (11 tests) is solid and exercises the inversion math and error paths via mocked fetch, matching this repo's existing whisper-client.ts convention. Given tier2 classification, this is ready for a human to merge, not something I can merge myself.
